lugares.pasillo: the aisle of an ordinary neighborhood supermarket in Latin America: long metal gondola shelves full of generic unbranded packages, white shelf-edge price labels, a worn speckled vinyl floor, long fluorescent tubes on the ceiling, a shopping cart left half-way
lugares.deposito: the back storeroom of a neighborhood supermarket: gray metal racks with cardboard boxes, a wooden pallet with shrink-wrapped boxes, a pallet jack, a bare fluorescent tube, a swinging door with a small round window to the sales floor
lugares.fiambreria: the deli counter of a neighborhood supermarket: a curved glass refrigerated display with cheeses and cold cuts on steel trays, a slicer machine, a white digital scale with a small label printer, white tiles behind
lugares.carniceria: the meat case of a neighborhood supermarket: an open refrigerated case with plastic-wrapped meat trays on white foam, white price labels, some trays with a red markdown sticker
lugares.caja: the checkout of a neighborhood supermarket: a black conveyor belt, a scanner window glowing red, a small customer display, a thermal receipt printer, candy racks next to the belt
